title: 'At a reading' and 'At a day of the year' due and overdue behaviour
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as a user with View customers, on the build under test. The Maintenance Reminders feature is on (maintenance_reminders flag).
  2. An asset is enrolled on a schedule whose service has more than one active trigger (e.g. a calendar interval and a mileage 'At' target), e.g. unit 'ZZAUTOTEST Truck 12'.
  3. Open the asset's Maintenance tab (the worklist and a work order's maintenance panel show the same rows).
custom_steps:
1. For a service set 'At' a reading, bring the unit to that reading.
  2. Complete it and confirm it never comes due again.
  3. For a service set 'At' a day of the year, pass that day; complete it early or late and check next year's date.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • A service set 'At' a reading comes due when the unit reaches it and stays overdue until done; once done it never comes due again.
  • A service set 'At' a day of the year comes due that day each year and stays overdue until done; next year's date appears only once it is done, and doing it early or late does not move it.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780 (Maintenance Reminders); story SV-10569 (S12, Due date resolution); Chunk 2 MR spec (Confluence 897679389), Part 2 / S12; read 2 Oct 2026. Source-verified 2 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S12-R3: “A service set "At" a reading comes due when the unit reaches it and stays overdue until it is done; once done, it never comes due again. A service set "At" a day of the year comes due on that day each year and stays overdue until it is done; next year's date appears only once it is done. Doing it early or late does not move next year's date”
  • S12-E2: “An "At" date does not move when the service is done early or late”
